tool.description: Remove common image color casts by white-balancing an image with either gray-world (neutralize average color) or white-patch (map brightest channel values toward white). strength is 0..100 percent and blends the correction with the original. Returns a PNG. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref from a prior tool call.

method.description: White-balance estimate to use: gray-world neutralizes average color; white-patch maps channel maxima toward white.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

strength.description: Correction strength as a percentage, 0 to 100 (0 = unchanged, 100 = full correction).

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
